questionText: What should our city do to improve residents' quality of life?
design: Accuracy benchmark corpus: 10 topics x 5 synth-groups x 2 near-paraphrases = 100 statements. Each paraphrase pair states the SAME action in different wording (target within-pair cosine >= 0.85, hard floor 0.78 = synthLowerBound). The 5 synth-groups inside a topic are deliberately DISTINCT actions on a shared theme (target 0.60-0.84) because generateSynthesizedProposal refuses to merge distinct actions. Topics are mutually distinct (target < 0.60 = clusterThreshold). Ground truth: 10 topic clusters, 50 synths. Frozen corpus - do not edit without re-running scripts/preflightCorpusCosines.ts.

synths.name: bus-frequency
paraphrases: Run buses more often during rush hour so people do not wait long.
Increase the number of buses at peak times to cut down waiting.

synths.name: protected-bike-lanes
paraphrases: Build protected bike lanes that are separated from car traffic.
Create physically separated cycling lanes so riders are shielded from cars.

synths.name: free-fares-youth
paraphrases: Make public transport free for students under eighteen.
Let all school-age children ride public transit at no charge.

synths.name: night-service
paraphrases: Operate night buses on weekends so people can get home late.
Add late-night weekend transit service for people traveling after midnight.

synths.name: real-time-arrivals
paraphrases: Provide a real-time arrival app that shows exactly when the bus is coming.
Give riders live vehicle tracking in an app so they know arrival times.

synths.name: affordable-quota
paraphrases: Require developers to include affordable units in every new building.
Mandate a share of below-market apartments in all new construction.

synths.name: public-rent-registry
paraphrases: Create a public rent registry so tenants can compare prices.
Publish a municipal database of rents so renters can see real market rates.

synths.name: convert-offices
paraphrases: Convert empty office buildings into apartments.
Turn vacant commercial buildings into residential housing.

synths.name: renovation-grants
paraphrases: Give grants to renovate old apartments for energy efficiency.
Fund subsidies for upgrading aging flats so they use less energy.

synths.name: student-dorms
paraphrases: Build subsidized dormitories for students near the campuses.
Construct low-cost student housing close to the colleges.

synths.name: neighborhood-parks
paraphrases: Ensure a small green park sits within a five-minute walk of every home.
Create pocket parks so each resident has green space a short walk away.

synths.name: street-trees
paraphrases: Plant many more shade trees along the streets.
Line the sidewalks with trees so pedestrians get shade.

synths.name: community-gardens
paraphrases: Allocate plots for community vegetable gardens.
Give residents land where they can grow vegetables together in shared gardens.

synths.name: accessible-playgrounds
paraphrases: Make every playground accessible to children with disabilities.
Rebuild play areas so that kids with disabilities can use all the equipment.

synths.name: dog-parks
paraphrases: Create fenced dog-run areas in each district.
Set up enclosed off-leash areas for dogs in every neighborhood.

synths.name: street-lighting
paraphrases: Improve street lighting on dark streets and footpaths.
Install brighter lamps along poorly lit roads and walkways.

synths.name: traffic-calming
paraphrases: Add speed bumps and narrowed crossings near schools.
Install traffic-calming measures such as humps and curb extensions beside schools.

synths.name: community-policing
paraphrases: Put neighborhood officers who know the residents on regular patrol.
Assign local beat officers who build ongoing relationships with residents.

synths.name: emergency-response-time
paraphrases: Cut ambulance and fire response times by opening more local stations.
Reduce how long emergency services take to arrive by adding stations closer to neighborhoods.

synths.name: cameras-at-hotspots
paraphrases: Install security cameras at the crime hotspots.
Put surveillance cameras in the places where crime is concentrated.

synths.name: smaller-classes
paraphrases: Reduce class sizes so teachers can give individual attention.
Cap the number of pupils per classroom to allow personal attention.

synths.name: teacher-pay
paraphrases: Raise teacher salaries to attract and keep good educators.
Increase pay for teachers so that strong educators stay in the profession.

synths.name: homework-tutoring
paraphrases: Provide free after-school homework tutoring for pupils who fall behind.
Offer no-cost afternoon tutoring so struggling students get help with assignments.

synths.name: school-buildings
paraphrases: Renovate old school buildings with modern classrooms and laboratories.
Modernize aging school facilities including their labs and classrooms.

synths.name: school-meals
paraphrases: Serve a free hot lunch to every pupil at school.
Provide no-cost hot meals for all students during the school day.

synths.name: neighborhood-clinics
paraphrases: Open primary-care clinics in underserved neighborhoods.
Add local family-health clinics in the areas that lack them.

synths.name: mental-health-services
paraphrases: Provide free mental-health counseling for residents.
Offer no-cost psychological therapy services to the public.

synths.name: specialist-wait-times
paraphrases: Shorten the waiting times for specialist appointments.
Cut how long patients wait before they can see a specialist doctor.

synths.name: preventive-screening
paraphrases: Run free screening campaigns for early detection of disease.
Offer no-charge check-up programs that catch illness at an early stage.

synths.name: elderly-home-care
paraphrases: Expand home-care services so seniors can stay in their own homes.
Increase in-home support so older people do not have to move to institutions.

synths.name: small-business-loans
paraphrases: Give low-interest loans to small local businesses.
Offer cheap credit to small neighborhood businesses.

synths.name: job-retraining
paraphrases: Fund retraining programs for workers changing careers.
Pay for reskilling courses for people switching occupations.

synths.name: cut-permit-bureaucracy
paraphrases: Simplify the business licensing process down to one short form.
Cut business-permit red tape to a single quick application.

synths.name: local-hiring
paraphrases: Require city contractors to hire local residents.
Make municipal suppliers employ people from within the city.

synths.name: coworking-spaces
paraphrases: Open subsidized coworking spaces for freelancers.
Provide low-cost shared offices for independent workers.

synths.name: free-museum-days
paraphrases: Make the museums free to enter one day a week.
Offer no-charge museum admission on one day of every week.

synths.name: neighborhood-libraries
paraphrases: Open a public library branch in every neighborhood.
Put a local library in each district of the city.

synths.name: street-festivals
paraphrases: Hold regular street festivals and outdoor concerts.
Organize frequent public festivals and open-air music events.

synths.name: public-art-commissions
paraphrases: Commission murals and sculptures from local artists for public squares.
Pay local artists to create wall paintings and statues around the city.

synths.name: youth-music-programs
paraphrases: Fund free music lessons for children.
Pay for no-cost instrument instruction for kids.

synths.name: recycling-pickup
paraphrases: Collect recycling from every doorstep once a week.
Provide weekly curbside pickup of recyclable materials.

synths.name: solar-on-public-roofs
paraphrases: Put solar panels on the roofs of all public buildings.
Install photovoltaic systems on top of municipal buildings.

synths.name: ban-single-use-plastic
paraphrases: Ban single-use plastics in shops and restaurants.
Prohibit disposable plastic items at stores and eateries.

synths.name: compost-organic-waste
paraphrases: Set up separate collection of kitchen food scraps for composting.
Create a dedicated food-waste stream that gets turned into compost.

synths.name: air-quality-monitoring
paraphrases: Install air-quality sensors across the city and publish the data.
Deploy pollution monitors citywide with public real-time readings.

synths.name: online-permits
paraphrases: Let residents complete all municipal forms online.
Enable every city procedure to be carried out over the internet.

synths.name: public-wifi
paraphrases: Provide free public wifi in the squares and community centers.
Offer no-charge wireless internet in public plazas and community centers.

synths.name: walk-in-help-desks
paraphrases: Open walk-in help desks where residents get assistance using the city's online services.
Staff in-person support counters that help people navigate the municipal website.

synths.name: open-data-portal
paraphrases: Publish the city budget and city data in an open portal.
Release municipal data and spending on a public open-data website.

synths.name: single-service-hotline
paraphrases: Create a single phone number for all city service requests.
Set up one unified hotline for every municipal service request.
